topic: Analytics data gap creation and review
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing analytics data, specifically the creation of 'gap' datasets for mall sessions. Multiple gap versions (gap 1 and gap 2) were generated using staging links and shared with [p1]. The criteria for these gaps included a minimum session duration (>= 60 seconds). Concerns were raised regarding unique traffic fluctuations and whether the model was correctly recalculated for a specific company number (7880).

[me] confirmed that the correct formula for footfall calculation, based on unique users, had been implemented. The discussion concluded with [me] making the latest version of the data available for review.
decisions: Multiple gap datasets were created and shared for analytics review.
